items.title: Living room look without a false ceiling - reference 1
items.notes: Use this as a look and rendering reference for the living/drawing room. Try to achieve the look without a false ceiling. — Applied 2026-10-03 (layout C): cream sofas with terracotta cushions, two carved wood panels over the west sofa, table lamps, rug, warm floor-length curtains beside the south window and a floor plant. No false ceiling. Not applied: the woven pendant (the existing ring chandelier is kept).

items.title: Living room look without a false ceiling - reference 2
items.notes: Use this as an alternative look and rendering reference for the living/drawing room. Try to achieve the look without a false ceiling. — Applied 2026-10-03 together with reference 1 (same Drawing Room styling).

items.title: Kitchen shaft wall treatment
items.notes: Apply this idea to the kitchen shaft wall. Use the pin as a visual reference for the wall treatment. — Applied 2026-10-03: black wire grid with hanging herb pots on the shaft east face, replacing the three pottery wall planters. The patterned tile cladding stays; the reference shows a wood wall.

items.title: Kitchen appliance garage
items.notes: Explore this appliance-garage idea for the kitchen. Use the pin as a reference for the look and concealed appliance storage; exact placement is not yet decided. — Already in the model: an open appliance garage at counter height on the east wall (850 wide, with the food processor). The reference adds a lift-up door and a pull-out tray; not modelled, placement and door type still to decide.

items.title: Kitchen wood texture and finish
items.notes: Use this pin as a reference for the kitchen wood texture and finish. — Applied 2026-10-03: the kitchen now defaults to white oak veneer. If the kitchen still shows teak, choose White oak for the Kitchen under Interior studio > Materials (a saved setting in the browser overrides the default).

items.title: Hidden spice rack in the kitchen
items.notes: Explore a hidden spice rack in the kitchen using this pin as an idea reference. — Partly in the model: slider storage behind the backsplash (4 in deep along the east wall, 6 in deep on the west). The reference is a full-height pull-out beside the hob; not modelled, position still to decide.

items.title: Cabinet beside the bed
items.notes: Consider a cabinet on the side of the bed. This may make sense because the bed area is not used throughout the day. Explore the idea before changing the layout. — Explored 2026-10-03 as a preview only (Bedroom 3 > Show bedside cabinet idea): a tall mirror-door cabinet 880 wide x 380 deep x 2400 high on the east wall north of the bed, with overhead cabinets across the headboard. It leaves 33 mm to the toilet door frame and takes the floor between the bed and the north wall, so that side of the bed is no longer walkable. Layout not changed.
